Package drone.pheroswarm

Class DecentralizedExploration

java.lang.Object
drone.pheroswarm.DecentralizedExploration
public final class DecentralizedExploration extends Object
Runs decentralized frontier selection on local occupancy maps.

The simulation uses one shared digital pheromone field and synchronous steps. Ground truth supports sensing, motion validation, and evaluation rather than frontier selection. Construction runs the simulation and updates the supplied drone paths.

    • DecentralizedExploration

      public DecentralizedExploration(int[][] environment, ArrayList<Drone> agents)
      Runs an exploration simulation using the JVM configuration.
      Parameters:
      environment - occupancy grid indexed by row and column, with -1 marking obstacles
      agents - drones in simulation order, with distinct free starting cells
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the grid is empty, a start is invalid or duplicated, or the configuration is invalid
      UncheckedIOException - if the configured trace cannot be written

    • DecentralizedExploration

      public DecentralizedExploration(int[][] environment, ArrayList<Drone> agents, ExplorationConfig config)
      Runs an exploration simulation using the supplied configuration.
      Parameters:
      environment - occupancy grid indexed by row and column, with -1 marking obstacles
      agents - drones in simulation order, with distinct free starting cells
      config - validated settings for this run
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the grid is empty, a start is invalid or duplicated, or the configuration is invalid
      UncheckedIOException - if the configured trace cannot be written

    • selectRoute

      private List<Point> selectRoute(int id)
      Selects a frontier using shortest-path distance and the repulsive pheromone penalty.

      Dijkstra uses geometric edge costs on the local occupancy map. The sum of pheromone values along each candidate route, excluding its origin, changes the frontier score rather than the edge costs.

      Parameters:
      id - zero-based drone index
      Returns:
      route from the current cell to the selected frontier, including both endpoints, or an empty list if none is available
